candidates.name: Plate Bicep Curl
candidates.cardText:
Plate Bicep Curl
Novice
1
Hold plate in both hands.
2
Flex your elbows until the plate nears your chest.
3
Extend your elbows until they are fully extended.

candidates.name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press
candidates.cardText:
Plate Curl To Overhead Press
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
2
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
3
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
4
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.

candidates.name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
candidates.cardText:
Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
Advanced
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
2
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
3
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
4
Lower the plate back behind the head to the starting position of a tricep extension.
5
Push the plate back up overhead, then lower it back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.

candidates.name: Plate Squat Hold Curl
candidates.cardText:
Plate Squat Hold Curl
Intermediate
1
Lower into a squat position, keeping the plate at chest height.
2
Slowly curl the plate towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
3
Hold for a moment at the top of the curl before lowering the plate back to chest height.
4
Repeat the curls as you hold the squat position.

candidates.name: Plate Pinch Grip Row
candidates.cardText:
Plate Pinch Grip Row
Intermediate
1
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.
2
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
3
Pull the plate toward your upper abdomen.
4
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.

candidates.name: Weighted Chin Ups
candidates.cardText:
Weighted Chin Ups
Advanced
1
Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
2
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
3
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.
